issue.title: SafeConfigProxy silently returns None for unmapped attrs, defeating getattr()'s default arg -- caused a live turn-killing crash
issue.symptom:
LIVE OUTAGE 2026-10-13 (Mission Control chat, session reported by user): a
casual "Good afternoon, how are you today?" turn crashed twice in sequence
and the client got nothing back (dropped stream, not even the synthesized
error packet). Root cause traced via docker logs gaia-core:

1. self_reflection.py:63 `if output_tokens > MAX_REFLECTION_TOKENS:` threw
   TypeError: '>' not supported between instances of 'int' and 'NoneType'.
   MAX_REFLECTION_TOKENS came from `getattr(config, 'max_reflection_tokens',
   500)` -- should default to 500, got None instead.
2. Immediately after, a SECOND crash: dev_matrix_analyzer.py:26
   `Path(getattr(config, 'base_path', '/gaia/GAIA_Project/gaia-assistant'))`
   threw TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike, not NoneType -- same
   pattern. This one was UNCAUGHT (agent_core.py only wrapped the call in
   `except ImportError`), so it propagated out of run_turn()'s generator and
   killed the whole streaming response outright.

ROOT CAUSE: SafeConfigProxy (agent_core.py ~line 105), which wraps the real
Config object as `self.config` throughout AgentCore and everything it calls
into (self_reflection.py, dev_matrix_analyzer.py, etc.), has a __getattr__
that NEVER raises AttributeError for an unknown name -- it returns
`fallback_map.get(name, None)`, i.e. None for anything outside its own
small hardcoded fallback_map (max_tokens, max_tokens_lite, temperature,
top_p, cheat_sheet, cheat_sheet_path, MODEL_CONFIGS). This silently defeats
every OTHER caller's own `getattr(config, X, default)` default argument --
Python only falls back to that default when __getattr__ raises
AttributeError, which this proxy is specifically designed never to do.

FIXED (this session, both symptoms): guarded the two confirmed crash sites
with `getattr(...) or default` (self_reflection.py: MAX_REFLECTION_TOKENS,
iterations, threshold, max_tokens, reflection_temperature, SAMVEGA_THRESHOLD
-- all in the same function/call chain; dev_matrix_analyzer.py: base_path).
Also widened agent_core.py's dev_matrix_analyzer try/except from
`except ImportError` to also catch `except Exception` (logged, non-fatal)
so this specific best-effort bookkeeping step can never again kill a live
turn regardless of what future bug lurks inside it. Verified live: repeated
the exact failing turn post-fix, no crash, response delivered (via the
GAIA-CORE-081 safety net this time, cleanly). 569 existing gaia-core
cognition tests still green.

NOT FIXED -- remaining scope, needs a dedicated audit: grepped for
`getattr(self.config,` / `getattr(config,` across gaia-core and found ~20
more call sites using the bare getattr-default pattern (not the `or`
guard) that are POTENTIALLY vulnerable to this exact footgun whenever the
underlying real Config object genuinely lacks that attribute (which is the
normal/correct trigger condition, not a misuse) -- e.g. heartbeat.py,
idle_heartbeat.py, lite_journal.py, temporal_state_manager.py,
temporal_interviewer.py, stream_observer.py, prime_checkpoint.py,
council_notes.py, session_manager.py. Several ALREADY use the safe
`getattr(..., None) or default` pattern (sleep_wake_manager.py,
gaia_rescue_helper.py, external_voice.py in places) -- worth normalizing
everything to that pattern, or better: fix SafeConfigProxy itself to
actually raise AttributeError when the underlying real config has no
answer (restores Python's normal getattr-default contract for every
caller at once) IF that doesn't break code that currently relies on the
"always returns None, never raises" guarantee -- needs careful review
before changing the proxy's core contract, which is why this wasn't done
under time pressure during a live-fix session. Also worth a lint rule /
grep-based test asserting new getattr(config, ...) call sites always use
the `or default` guard.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_config_bool.py
"""Unit tests for _config_bool (md2o): SafeConfigProxy's __getattr__ never
raises AttributeError for unmapped names -- it returns None instead, which
silently defeats getattr()'s own default argument for boolean flags like
_slim_prompt. _config_bool substitutes the default only when the proxy's
answer is None, while still respecting an explicit, genuine False (a plain
`or default` guard would wrongly flip that back to True)."""

from gaia_core.cognition.agent_core import _config_bool


def test_missing_attr_returns_default_true():
    proxy = _StubProxy(_StubRaw())
    assert _config_bool(proxy, "_slim_prompt", True) is True


def test_missing_attr_returns_default_false():
    proxy = _StubProxy(_StubRaw())
    assert _config_bool(proxy, "_slim_prompt", False) is False


def test_explicit_true_is_preserved():
    raw = _StubRaw()
    raw._slim_prompt = True
    proxy = _StubProxy(raw)
    assert _config_bool(proxy, "_slim_prompt", False) is True


def test_explicit_false_is_preserved_not_flipped_to_default():
    raw = _StubRaw()
    raw._slim_prompt = False
    proxy = _StubProxy(raw)
    # This is the exact case a plain `getattr(...) or default` guard gets
    # wrong: False or True == True, silently overriding a real, intentional
    # False. _config_bool must not do that.
    assert _config_bool(proxy, "_slim_prompt", True) is False

diff --git a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/agent_core.py b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/agent_core.py
index 36f0fc2..d0eb36d 100644
--- a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/agent_core.py
+++ b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/agent_core.py
@@ -162,6 +162,17 @@ class SafeConfigProxy:
         return True
 
 
+def _config_bool(config, name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
+    """getattr(config, name, default) for boolean flags on SafeConfigProxy,
+    which returns None (not AttributeError) for unmapped names, defeating
+    getattr()'s own default arg (md2o). Plain `or default` is unsafe here
+    specifically because it would silently flip a genuine, intentional
+    False back to True; this only substitutes the default when the proxy's
+    answer is None."""
+    val = getattr(config, name, default)
+    return default if val is None else val

commit_subject: fix(md2o): restore getattr() default semantics for boolean/string config flags defeated by SafeConfigProxy
